ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white pixels to 30% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions on the lateral lobes; central low-intensity black anchor-shaped region extending from the base toward the trailing edge. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency stippled mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-8 pixels; most pronounced towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep along the trailing boundary from the notch to the tips, tapering to acute points at the extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters observed at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple near-vertical low-intensity linear disruptions (scratches); notably three parallel marks on the left lobe and several fine-line disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible vertical rake-mark scars on both ventral lobes and barnacle-like clusters on the outer margins of the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular fractal-like pigmentation boundary between the central black region and the white lateral lobes.
